name: Crown Ether Visualizer
description: An interactive host-guest chemistry simulator visualising crown ether rings (12-crown-4, 15-crown-5, 18-crown-6, 21-crown-7) and their metal cation size-matching behavior (Li+, Na+, K+, Rb+, Cs+) with physical/geometric calculations, custom SVG animations, and thermodynamic binding curves.
